# function: estimate_cost

Calculates total cost based on size name, duration, and unit (days, weeks, months, hours). Uses current SHC pricing.



## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
estimate_cost(size string, duration number, unit string) object
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `size` (String) The size name (e.g. nvme-2c-8gb, dev-4c-16gb)
1. `duration` (Number) The number of units (e.g. 30 for 30 days, 4 for 4 weeks)
1. `unit` (String) The time unit: 'hours', 'days', 'weeks', or 'months'. Default: 'days'.
